* Added a "Listen in background" button: the sound keeps playing when you leave the video or lock your phone
* The video page now follows your phone's light or dark theme
* The subtitles button now picks the auto-generated subtitles in the video's own language, or English, instead of a random dubbed language
* Moved the "more" button next to Subscribe
* Smoother playback: fewer stalls and faster recovery from streaming errors (SmartTube 32.68)
